programme.desc: Taking viewers onto the floor of the exchange, right to the posts where the big companies in the world trade; tick charts track the action of every trade of every stock; the treasury, currency and commodity action in real time.

programme.title: Halftime Report
programme.desc: The front lines of market coverage; host Scott Wapner and the top investors get to the heart of the action as it's happening and help set the agenda for the rest of the day.

programme.title: The Exchange
programme.desc: Anchor Kelly Evans reports on the important stories to markets and investors; reporters provide actionable information to viewers as they make daily investment decisions.

programme.title: Power Lunch
programme.desc: Focusing on real-time market coverage, breaking news and up-to-the-instant stock moving information; delving into the economy, the markets, real estate, media and technology -- any place where there's money to be made.

programme.title: Closing Bell
programme.desc: A guide through the most important hour of the Wall Street trading day, and taking a close-up look at how the markets are moving, what's driving them and how investors are reacting; coverage includes reports from the CME Group, NASDAQ and the NYSE.

programme.title: Closing Bell: Overtime
programme.desc: Melissa Lee and Michael Santoli take viewers through all the after-hours moves including breaking news, corporate earnings and post-market trading; strategists and money managers debate actionable ideas and the market themes of the day.

programme.title: Fast Money
programme.desc: The information normally reserved for the Wall Street trading floor, enabling viewers to make decisions that give them a chance to make money; the news with an angle that won't be seen until tomorrow's papers.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Taking viewers inside the mind of one of Wall Street's most respected and successful money managers; Jim Cramer guides viewers through the confusing jungle of Wall Street investing, navigating through both opportunities and pitfalls.

programme.title: Squawk Box Asia
programme.desc: The hosts provide in-depth coverage of Asian stock markets and invite experts to offer their predictions and investment tips.

programme.title: Managing Asia
programme.desc: Sega Sammy. Christine Tan travels to Tokyo to talk to Haruki Satomi, CEO of Sega Sammy Group to find out what's next for the company behind the iconic game franchise Sonic the Hedgehog and how it plans to speed ahead of the competition.

programme.title: Managing Asia
programme.desc: Straits Trading. Christine Tan interviews Chew Gek Khim, who leads Straits Trading; they discuss how Chew transformed the old company into a real estate giant and her future plans.

programme.title: Executive Decisions
programme.desc: IIF's Tim Adams. The CEO of the Institute of International Finance reflects on pivotal career choices, ranging from turning down Enron to joining George W. Bush's presidential campaign; Tim Adams warns of a global debt crisis.

programme.title: Executive Decisions
programme.desc: London Stock Exchange's Julia Hoggett. The CEO of the London Stock Exchange reflects on why she didn't want to follow in the footsteps of her renowned lawyer parents, her decision to come out as gay while a young banker in the City, and the bold steps she's taking to modernize the LSE.

programme.title: Access Middle East
programme.desc: Exploring key business centers of the Middle East region with interviews of business leaders and policymakers.

programme.title: CNBC: U. S. Markets Edition
programme.desc: View updated U. S. market and world market charts; news on world economy and global markets in our Market Overview.

programme.title: Morning Call
programme.desc: Morgan Brennan delivers the essential market intelligence that drives the trading day ahead; capture breaking business news as it unfolds and tracks pre-market equity moves, commodity swings, U. S. futures, and overnight action across global markets.

programme.title: Fixer Upper

programme.title: Fixer Upper
programme.desc: Son Surprises Family with Reno. Empty nesters Kelvin and Culetta want a home for their children and grandchildren, and get help from their professional football player son.

programme.desc: Second Chance at a Country Home - S4E13. Jordan and Rachel dream of moving to the country with their three children, and enlist the help of Chip and Joanna after their contract falls through on another property in hopes of a second chance at country living. (03/07/2017)

programme.title: Fixer Upper
programme.desc: Space in the Suburbs - S4E11. San Diego transplants Mary and Dustyn are on the hunt for their family's dream home in Waco, Texas, and they're looking for a four-bedroom with a large yard and open space for hosting. (02/21/2017)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: City Slickers Off the Grid - S1E3. Chase and his team renovate an off-the-grid camp for a family of city slickers; with limited resources, the team members work to incorporate the comforts of city living, then they discover a moldering water tank that may shut down the renovation. (01/16/2017)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: Form, Function and Fun on Flying Pond - S8E14. A family loves their cozy, hilltop camp even though it lacks some basic amenities that make year-round visits difficult; the Cabin Masters employ all their skills to transform this unfinished gem from driveway to dock. (02/20/2023)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: A High Steaks Build - S11E5. The crew kicks off a new waterside build, but a surprise call from the homeowners could change everything; with icy delays, a custom grill pit and help from Francis, this episode is packed with challenges, charm, and unexpected turns. (07/14/2025)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: Not-So-Pleasant Camp on Pleasant Pond - S1E6. Chase and his team are called in to renovate a neglected camp for a growing family; the unusual footprint proves troublesome when trying to create a second bedroom; outside, the steep slope becomes a challenge just hours before the reveal. (02/06/2017)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: Hidden Trolley Family Camp - S8E15. A family wants to turn their worn and cozy fishing getaway into a modern vacation retreat; the Cabin Masters come to their aid with a massive expansion, raising the roof and combating big plumbing problems. (02/27/2023)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: Tree Damage to Lakeside Dream Cabin - S10E1. The Maine Cabin Masters team faces a challenging cabin restoration after a massive tree damage to a Maine camp; they'll raise ceilings, move the kitchen for lake views, rework the staircase and remove rooms for rustic charm. (12/30/2024)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: Six Weeks for Two A-Frames - S1E11. Chase and his team must renovate two A-frames in Maine's Sugarloaf Valley; with only six weeks to accomplish both renovations, Chase splits the team down the middle. (03/13/2017)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programme.desc: A Jen in Need - S10E8. When their business manager requests a brand-new build over a vacation-packed winter, the team loses track of the budget as time slips away and snow piles up; the crew try to finish the build without going any more over budget. (02/17/2025)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters

(03/04/2024)

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Bush Babies - S1E3. Baby Animals Down Under takes you on a spectacular trek around Australia to meet a wide variety of delightful youngsters that hop, climb, fly and swim through its wilds. In Forests, go piggybacking with Koala joeys and enjoy the rare sight of a Tree Kangaroo joey popping its head out of the pouch. On the Waterways, see baby Saltwater crocodiles emerge from their eggs, and go for a paddle with fluffy baby Black Swans. In the Outback, bound around with Red Kangaroo joeys and Emu chicks. Visit the Islands to catch baby Quokkas and Tasmanian Devils at play. In the Bush, be intrigued by baby Echidnas, known as puggles, and go for a leisurely waddle with some Wombat joeys. Plus, don't miss Green Sea turtles scramble for the waves, or the chance to tag along with Humpback Whale calves as they cruise the Coast with their majestic mums. (10/14/2026)

programme.title: World Poker Tour
programme.desc: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Poker Showdown - Part 1 - S16E22. The World Poker Tour features a collection of prestigious tournaments played in top casinos and card rooms across the globe, including the glamorous Bellagio in Las Vegas and the Aviation Club de France in Paris. It all leads up to the WPT Championship finale where the "survivor" walks away with more than $1 million. But that's just a fraction of the money up for grabs over the course of the series. The WPT widened the television audience for poker by injecting cutting-edge television production values into the dramatic world of high-stakes, upscale, tournament poker with its innovative WPT cams revealing the player's hole cards. (09/23/2018)

programme.title: The Neighborhood
programme.desc: Welcome to the Baby Shower - S6E8. Courtney and Marty deal with some baby shower drama with Tina; Lamar adjusts to a new job at the Fuse Box. (04/22/2024)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidtastic Voyage; That's No Lady. Squidward swallows his clarinet reed; Patrick disguises himself as a girl.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Mighty Pups. A meteor bathes the pups, Lookout Tower, and even Harold in its golden energy, granting them superpowers; Harold tries to use his new powers to become the sole ruler of Adventure Bay, but standing in his way are the heroic Mighty Pups.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Dinosaur Pirates. The Paw Patrol have to rescue Sid Swashbuckle when he recruits dinos to be his crew, which has some unexpected consequences.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Mission PAW: Royally Spooked!; Pups Save Monkey-Dinger. The pups go to Barkingburg to investigate when the Princess thinks she has seen a ghost; while on safari with Carlos and Tracker, Mayor Humdinger steals a magic mask.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save Queen Cluck-Cluck; Pups Save a Desert Flounder. Mayor Goodway dreams she's traveled to the mysterious Cluck Cluck Island, a very strange land where Chickaletta is royalty; Traveling Travis' balloon gets caught on the Flounder.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Stop a Gold Finding Machine; Pups Help Mayor Humdinger Out of a Jam. The PAW Patrol springs into action when a digging machine goes out-of-control and takes Uncle Otis on a wild ride; Digi and Tal try to help Mayor Humdinger but leave the Mayor covered in jam, so the Pups must rescue him from hungry animals.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-Dino - S7E13. Mayor Humdinger and his Kitties go to Dino Wilds for Dino acting lessons but somehow find themselves bound for Adventure Bay. (07/11/2020)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Dino Documentary; Pups Save a Grump-A-Saurus. Vanessa Pressley is on Dino Island to film her new dino documentary; she and the cameraman get carried off by a Brachiosaurus; when Daring Danny X's dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus on his trail!

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a White Wolf; Pups Save a Wrong-Way Explorer. After a sudden snowstorm, Everest cares for a white wolf cub as they work together to help the PAW Patrol find them; famous wrong-way explorer Travelling Travis accidentally takes Chickaletta to the North Pole, where they run into some crocodiles.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Search and Rescue: Pups Help the Chickens Cross the Road; Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Lost Ryder. Chickaletta's family is scattered around town, causing traffic jams; the Safety and Rescue Pups have to help the chickens cross the road; Chase leads a mission to rescue a lost Ryder which involves clues, tools and Chewington.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds a Big Bike Shop; The Crew Builds a Super Tub. Rubble and the pups work to build a big bike shop in time for the Bike Festival, unless Speed Meister beats them to it; when Motor won't take a bath before their family photo, it's up to Rubble and the pups to find a construction solution.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save Thundermouth; Pups Save a Class Pet. Shortly after listening to the story of Thundermouth, the pups are on a mission to save elephants spooked by a scary noise; Mayor Goodway is left in charge of a class pet, but the hamster escapes.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Air Rescue: Pups Save the Mother Tree; Pups Save the Ice Cream Truck. Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree; it's then up to the Paw Patrol to fix Mr. Porter's ice cream freezer before everything melts!

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Director; Pups Save the Super Cows. Francois is directing a video when his camera crane rolls away; all the farm animals go missing from the Super Farm Fair.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save Little Hairy; Pups Save a Kooky Climber. Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole, and Tracker gets carried away by Big Hairy; Danny tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorenson.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
